mode_a_os_automation.limiting_factor: Physical hardware cursor, single active window focus, and display session 1 lock
mode_a_os_automation.explanation: Nut.js operates directly against the host OS desktop coordinates. Concurrent automation instructions will collide and disrupt the shared mouse and keyboard pointer.

mode_b_headless_api_and_companion.mode_name: Headless Web Companion & API Hub (remote/web.js + users.js)
mode_b_headless_api_and_companion.max_concurrent_users_single_seat: Scales with GPU VRAM KV-cache slots and Node.js event loop
mode_b_headless_api_and_companion.limiting_factor: GPU VRAM KV-cache capacity and memory bandwidth

model_qwen3_vl_8b.note: Exceeding 1 concurrent 8K user causes Vulkan memory spillover to system RAM via PCIe, reducing generation speed by 60-75%.

model_qwen3_4b.note: Best candidate for multi-user headless companion serving on 8GB VRAM.

architectural_blockers_for_multi_tenancy.description: Windows interactive desktop session 1 is shared. Concurrent mouse actions collide.
SQLite and chat history files are structured for single-installation multi-user profiles, but do not provide cryptographically separated per-user database partitions.

architectural_blockers_for_multi_tenancy.blocker: Single Model Context Slot by Default
architectural_blockers_for_multi_tenancy.description: Embedded llama-server is currently invoked with default single-sequence slot unless launched with --parallel or -np flags in server.js.

tier_1_single_user_personal_appliance.target_workload: Real-time desktop automation, vision perception, coding, voice assistant
tier_1_single_user_personal_appliance.min_cpu: 6 Cores / 12 Threads (AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel i5-12400)

tier_2_small_office_home_hub.target_workload: Headless web companion, chat, document summarization, background autonomous agents
tier_2_small_office_home_hub.target_gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 / RTX 5070 / RTX 4060 Ti 16GB

tier_3_department_enterprise_server.target_workload: Multi-agent continuous execution, concurrent RAG vector search, parallel voice & text
tier_3_department_enterprise_server.target_gpu: 2x NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB) or 2x RTX 5090 (32GB) or NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada

tier_4_large_scale_cloud_cluster.target_workload: Distributed microservices, vLLM inference cluster, virtualized sandboxed desktop containers
